functions.title: Responsibilities
content: Participate in new application development and existing system enhancements
Troubleshoot and resolve online issues regarding InfoShare® application and data
Conduct deployment of InfoShare® application updates/release and data remediation
Identify and document business/technical requirement specifications for specific InfoShare® application design/development, interfaces, process, and other relevant changes
Assist with the setup of applications, including 3rd party interface implementation and testing
May assist account managers to solve urgent online issues during non-business hours

functions.title: Requirement
content: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field in Science/Engineering
Familiarity with .Net Framework, C#, Java Script

functions.title: Responsibilities
content: Design, develop, and execute procedures to convert client data in various environments (SQL) into InfoShare® application
Troubleshoot and resolve online issues regarding InfoShare® data
Conduct deployment of data conversion and data remediation
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify data patterns and anomalies
May conduct deployment of data conversion during non-business hours
